records.description: Stay connected through our email newsletter and GroupMe for company info sessions, professional development events, socials, leadership opportunities, and chapter updates.
headings: Get connected with Ohio State's mechanical engineering community.
records.text: 466+ Members 25+ Events / Year 🏆 2026 ASME Achievement Award Join ASME OSU Get connected with Ohio State's mechanical engineering community. Stay connected through our email newsletter and GroupMe for company info sessions, professional development events, socials, leadership opportunities, and chapter updates. Industry EventsMeet employers and learn about engineering careers. CommunityConnect with other mechanical engineering students. LeadershipFind ways to get involved beyond attending events. 1 Email newsletterFull announcements 2 GroupMeFast updates Step 1 · Email Newsletter Become a member This form signs you up for the ASME OSU email newsletter. You'll receive event announcements, chapter news, and opportunities in your inbox. First Name * Last Name * OSU Name.# Graduation Year * OSU Email * Complete step 1 Please enable JavaScript to sign up here, or email asme@osu.edu for help. 2 Step 2 · GroupMe Get the quick updates. Join the chapter GroupMe for reminders, event changes, and member conversation. Continue to GroupMe Already receive our emails? You can go straight to this step. Questions Frequently Asked Questions New to ASME OSU? Here are a few quick answers before you join. Do I need to be a mechanical engineering major to join? No. ASME OSU is especially focused on mechanical engineering, but students from related engineering majors and anyone interested in design, manufacturing, robotics, energy, aerospace, automotive, or professional development are welcome. Is there a membership fee? Joining the ASME OSU newsletter and GroupMe is free. ASME National membership is separate: freshmen and first-year students receive their first year free when they enter their expected graduation date during signup. Other students can use code SECTION at checkout for 25% off. Any costs for special events, trips, or optional activities will be shared ahead of time. What kinds of events does ASME OSU host? We host company info sessions, technical talks, networking events, socials, resume and career development events, leadership opportunities, and occasional collaborations with other student organizations. Can first-year students join? Yes. First-year students are encouraged to join early. ASME is a great way to meet other students, learn about engineering careers, and start building connections before internship recruiting begins. How will I hear about upcoming events? Sign up for the email newsletter for full announcements and join the ASME OSU GroupMe for quick reminders and day-of updates. You can also check the events calendar and follow ASME OSU on social media. How can I get more involved beyond attending events? Come to meetings, talk with current officers, volunteer at events, and watch for leadership applications or committee opportunities. We are always looking for students who want to help shape the chapter.

records.title: About ASME OSU
records.description: Our mission is to connect Ohio State students with industry, practical experience, and a supportive engineering community so they can grow as professionals and leaders.
headings: Build your engineering network before graduation.
Use ASME in the way that helps you most.
Professional growth feels better with a community.
An active network on campus and beyond.
A simple path from first event to real involvement.
See what ASME OSU is like for yourself.
records.text: Ohio State ASME Student Chapter Build your engineering network before graduation. Our mission is to connect Ohio State students with industry, practical experience, and a supportive engineering community so they can grow as professionals and leaders. View Upcoming Events → Join the Chapter Student led All interested students welcome What Members Do Use ASME in the way that helps you most. Come to one event or help shape the chapter. There is a useful next step whether you are exploring engineering, preparing for recruiting, or ready to lead. 01 Meet Employers Hear directly from engineers and recruiters through company sessions, technical talks, and networking events. 02 Build Practical Skills Practice career skills, learn beyond the classroom, and take part in workshops, projects, and competitions. 03 Find Your Community Meet students across class years through socials, outreach, service, and chapter collaborations. 04 Lead and Serve Volunteer, organize events, support other members, and pursue committee or executive-board roles. Chapter in Action Professional growth feels better with a community. You do not need to be a mechanical engineering major or arrive with experience. Start with an event that interests you, meet a few people, and build from there. Industry conversations Hands-on challenges Community beyond class Chapter Impact An active network on campus and beyond. These figures summarize the community and programming that members can plug into throughout the academic year. 466+ Students in Our Community 25+ Events Each Year 20+ Industry Relationships 2026 National Recognition National Recognition 2026 Student Section Achievement Award ASME recognized the Ohio State student section for strong programming, member engagement, industry connections, and service. The award reflects the work of the students, partners, and volunteers who keep the chapter moving. What a Semester Looks Like A simple path from first event to real involvement. There is no single required path. This is how many members turn a first visit into useful relationships, experience, and leadership. 01 Discover Join the mailing list and choose an event that matches your interests. 02 Connect Meet members, officers, engineers, and recruiters in a low-pressure setting. 03 Participate Return for a workshop, social, project, outreach activity, or company session. 04 Contribute Volunteer, share an idea, help run an event, or explore a leadership role. Your Next Step See what ASME OSU is like for yourself. Start with an upcoming event or join the chapter mailing list. Companies interested in supporting student engineers can also connect with our corporate team. View Upcoming Events → Join ASME OSU Interested in partnering with the chapter? Explore sponsorship →
